item_short_desc: Protect your belongings from the rain with Sno-Seal Silicone Water-Guard. This protective spray is ideal for outdoor gear like outwear, footwear, sleeping bags, tents, suede items, and more. Its silicone formula offers maximum repellency with a single application. The water guard restores factory waterproofing while allowing materials to remain flexible. The solution also protects against stains.
